profile.Name: Moll
profile.Personality: Cold, clear, and tactical. She built a hidden village in hostile country and keeps it alive through hard choices.
profile.Backstory: She leads the Flotsam Ninjas from their hidden village near the Cannibal Plains. The Holy Nation has put a bounty on her head.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks in assessments; asks what you can do before asking why you came.
